_file: damned_waters/game/data/rooms/rokin_zuid.json — RoomSpec for Rokin (the city, district 3: Rokin): the south half of Rokin, the main road north to the Dam and Centraal: the basin along its west side with the glass-roofed tour boats at their piers (one heeled over, taking water), the trams' rails, a grand hotel, the Allard Pierson museum in its old bank; dropped luggage, a taxi left with its door open, leaflets everywhere. Modelled after openly licensed photographs; every business name is made up, the landmarks keep theirs. The power is still on; nobody is there. Outdoor (street.py, city.py and landmarks.py build it). Single source of truth for Blender (render) and the engine (collision, cameras, things).

interactables.text: The tour boats, moored for the night. One of them is heeling over, slowly filling. Its lights are still on inside.
The meter's still running. The keys are in it. The driver's door is open; the seat is soaked.
The Allard Pierson. Its doors are shut and chained.
EVACUATIEROUTE. CENTRAAL. Sprayed in a hurry, the paint run down the board. They were sending everyone north.
